D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Cyndi Munson runs furthest behind in Washington, Le Flore, Stephens. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 82% of voters, 43 to 55, where a 5 point gain is worth 4.12 points; Voters without a degree, 65% of voters, 46 to 53, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.25 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 65% of voters, 44 to 54, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.25 points.
